atv-migrino.name: Migriño ATV
atv-migrino.tagline: The classic ride: desert, canyon, riverbed and Pacific shoreline
atv-migrino.desc:
This is the tour almost everyone starts with, and for good reason. You set off between cardón cactus and mesquite, drop into a canyon, cross the widest riverbed in the area and come out suddenly onto the open Pacific beach. Two hours that feel short.

You ride your own ATV, with a guide up front setting the pace and another closing the group. We stop several times for photos and to let first-timers build confidence before the faster stretch.
highlights: The Migriño riverbed, the most fun stretch of the route
Direct exit onto the open Pacific beach
Unhurried photo stops
Ideal if it's your first time on an ATV

itinerary.title: Arrival and gear
itinerary.text: We welcome you, hand out helmet and goggles, and you sign in. We walk you through how the machine works.

itinerary.title: Practice and departure
itinerary.text: A practice loop on flat ground so you get a feel for the throttle and brake. Once everyone's ready, we head out.

itinerary.title: Desert and canyon
itinerary.text: A climb through the cardones with valley views, then down into the canyon. First photo stop.

itinerary.title: Riverbed and beach
itinerary.text: The wide riverbed stretch and out onto the open beach. Second stop — the one with the best photos.

itinerary.title: Return and tequila
itinerary.text: Back to camp and a tequila tasting before you board the van.

atv-playa-dunas.name: ATV Beach & Dunes
atv-playa-dunas.desc:
The longer, faster version. Same area, but with automatic 4x4 machines and a route that spends half its time on open beach and dune fields.

Recommended if you've ridden an ATV before or want the version with more sand and fewer stops. The automatic transmission lets you focus on steering instead of shifting.
highlights: Automatic 4x4 ATVs — more power, easier to ride
Twice the beach time of the classic tour
Soft-sand dune fields
Smaller groups

itinerary.title: Arrival and gear
itinerary.text: Sign-in, helmet and goggles, and a walkthrough of the automatic machine.

itinerary.title: Quick start
itinerary.text: Short practice loop and off we go. Being automatic, the learning curve is minimal.

itinerary.title: Dunes
itinerary.text: Into the dune fields. Climbs, drops and loose sand. Photo stop at the top.

itinerary.title: Open beach
itinerary.text: The long stretch facing the Pacific, waves alongside you the whole way.

itinerary.title: Return and tequila
itinerary.text: Back through the desert and a closing tequila tasting.

utv-side-by-side.name: Side by Side UTV
utv-side-by-side.tagline: Two seats side by side: the pick for couples or riding with a child
utv-side-by-side.desc:
A vehicle with a steering wheel, two belted seats and a roll cage. One drives, the other rides alongside — not behind. It's the best option when there are two of you and you'd rather not rent two machines, or when you're bringing a child.

The route is the same as the classic ride — desert, canyon, riverbed and beach — but the UTV is more stable and more comfortable, so it's the better call if an ATV doesn't appeal to you.
highlights: Steering wheel, seatbelts and roll cage
Your companion rides beside you, not behind
Passengers from age 5
The second seat costs nothing extra

itinerary.title: Arrival and gear
itinerary.text: Sign-in, helmet and goggles. We fit the belts and check the cage.

itinerary.title: Practice
itinerary.text: A practice loop to get used to the wheel and pedals, which feel very different from an ATV.

itinerary.title: Desert and canyon
itinerary.text: Route through the cardones and down into the canyon, with a photo stop.

itinerary.title: Riverbed and beach
itinerary.text: Riverbed crossing and out onto the Pacific shoreline.

itinerary.title: Return and tequila
itinerary.text: Back to camp and tequila tasting.

can-am-x3.name: Can-Am X3 Turbo
can-am-x3.tagline: Our premium machine, on the most demanding routes
can-am-x3.desc:
The top of the fleet for anyone who wants speed without going to the extreme. Turbo engine, long-travel suspension and a track width that lets you take the dunes and the riverbed at a pace no standard machine can handle.

The route changes too: we add stretches the other tours don't run. It goes out with a dedicated guide and groups capped at eight machines. If you've done the classic tour and wanted more, this is the next step.
highlights: Turbo engine and long-travel suspension
Extended route with exclusive stretches
Dedicated guide, groups capped at 8 machines
Two seats with four-point harnesses

itinerary.title: Arrival and briefing
itinerary.text: Sign-in and an X3-specific walkthrough: drive modes, harness and guide communication.

itinerary.title: Practice
itinerary.text: A longer practice loop than the other tours, given the machine's power.

itinerary.title: Extended route
itinerary.text: Desert and canyon stretches the other tours don't run, at higher speed.

itinerary.title: Dunes and beach
itinerary.text: Dune fields and out onto the open Pacific beach.

itinerary.title: Return and tequila
itinerary.text: Back to camp and tequila tasting.

maverick-turbo.name: Maverick RC/RS Turbo
maverick-turbo.tagline: 195 horsepower: the fastest machine in the fleet
maverick-turbo.desc:
This is the absolute top. A 195-horsepower turbo engine, race-grade suspension and a power-to-weight ratio that turns the riverbed into a track. This isn't a beginner's tour: we ask for previous off-road experience.

We run groups of six machines maximum, with a dedicated guide and radio contact. The route is the longest and most technical we operate, including high dune sections no other machine can climb.
highlights: 195-horsepower turbo engine
Race-grade suspension and radio contact with your guide
The most technical route we operate
Groups capped at 6 machines

itinerary.title: Sign-in and technical briefing
itinerary.text: We review your previous experience, fit the four-point harness and explain radio use.

itinerary.title: Circuit practice
itinerary.text: A calibration loop so you feel the turbo's response before heading out.

itinerary.title: Technical route
itinerary.text: Canyon, riverbed and the high dune sections reserved for this machine.

itinerary.title: Beach at speed
itinerary.text: The long Pacific stretch, where the machine delivers what it promises.

itinerary.title: Return and tequila
itinerary.text: Back to camp and tequila tasting.

mini-rzr.name: Mini RZR for kids
mini-rzr.tagline: Their own off-road machine on a controlled circuit, from age 10
mini-rzr.desc:
Scaled-down vehicles built so kids drive themselves, not ride as passengers. A closed, supervised circuit with limited top speed and one instructor per small group.

Parents can walk alongside or run their own tour meanwhile. It's the activity that makes kids the stars of the trip, and easily the one they brag about most afterwards.
highlights: Your child drives their own machine
Closed circuit with limited top speed
An instructor assigned to each group
Drivers from age 10, passengers from 7

itinerary.title: Welcome
itinerary.text: Sign-in, a helmet in their size, and a briefing in words they actually understand.

itinerary.title: Practice
itinerary.text: Slow laps on the flat until the instructor sees they're confident.

itinerary.title: Circuit
itinerary.text: The full circuit run, with gentle curves and sand climbs.

itinerary.title: Wrap-up
itinerary.text: One last free lap, photos with the machines and back to the parents.

camellos.name: Camel Ride
camellos.tagline: A guided walk through desert and beach, from age 5
camellos.desc:
Our camels live in a sanctuary registered with SEMARNAT, and they walk at their own pace, always accompanied by a handler on foot. This isn't a speed tour: it's about the landscape, the photos and time with the animals.

It's the activity that works best with small children and grandparents, and the one that almost always ends up being the photo people post from the trip.
highlights: Sanctuary registered with SEMARNAT
One handler on foot per group
From age 5, no experience needed
The best photo tour of your trip

itinerary.title: Welcome
itinerary.text: Sign-in and an introduction to the camels and their handlers.

itinerary.title: Getting on
itinerary.text: How to mount and dismount. The camels kneel so you can climb up calmly.

itinerary.title: Desert
itinerary.text: A walk through the cardones with valley views. Photo stop.

itinerary.title: Beach
itinerary.text: Out onto the Pacific shoreline, the most photogenic stretch of the ride.

itinerary.title: Return and tequila
itinerary.text: Back to the sanctuary, time for photos with the animals, and a tequila tasting for adults.

caballos.name: Beach Horseback Ride
caballos.tagline: An easy trot facing the Pacific waves
caballos.desc:
Gentle horses, a guide beside you the whole way, and a route that runs from the desert straight to the shoreline. You don't need to know how to ride: we set the pace to the group, and anyone who's never been on a horse gets a guide alongside them.

It's the calmest tour we run, and by far the best one at sunset.
highlights: No previous experience required
A guide beside you the entire ride
A long stretch along the Pacific shoreline
Spectacular on the 16:00 departure

itinerary.title: Welcome
itinerary.text: Sign-in and horse assignment based on your height and experience.

itinerary.title: How to ride
itinerary.text: Reins, posture and stopping. A short loop in the corral.

itinerary.title: Desert
itinerary.text: Out onto the desert trail at an easy walk.

itinerary.title: Beach
itinerary.text: The long stretch facing the waves, where anyone who wants to can trot.

itinerary.title: Return and tequila
itinerary.text: Back to the corral and tequila tasting.

sky-bike.name: Sky Bike
sky-bike.tagline: Pedal suspended above the canyon, from age 8
sky-bike.desc:
A fixed bicycle on a cable strung from one side of the canyon to the other, with 850 metres of aerial route. You sit and pedal at your own pace, in a double harness with an independent safety line. There's no free fall and no speed: it's height and views.

It works well for anyone who wants the canyon view without the adrenaline of a traditional zipline, and for families with kids from age 8.
highlights: 850 metres of aerial route above the canyon
Double harness and independent safety line
You go at your own pace, no free fall
From age 8

itinerary.title: Arrival and gear
itinerary.text: Sign-in, harness and helmet. Equipment check by the technician.

itinerary.title: Safety briefing
itinerary.text: How to sit, how to pedal, and what to do if you want to stop mid-line.

itinerary.title: First line
itinerary.text: The main canyon crossing, the highest stretch of the route.

itinerary.title: Second line
itinerary.text: The crossing back, with a view over the valley and the sea beyond.

itinerary.title: Wrap-up and tequila
itinerary.text: Gear removal and a tequila tasting for adults.

bici-electrica.name: Electric Bike
bici-electrica.tagline: Desert and beach without breaking a sweat — the bike does half the work
bici-electrica.desc:
Pedal-assist bicycles that handle the climbs for you. You ride the same desert-and-beach route as the motorized tours, but quietly and at a pace that lets you actually look at the landscape.

It's the pick for anyone who wants the exercise without finishing exhausted, and the easiest option for mixed groups where not everyone is at the same fitness level.
highlights: Electric assist on the climbs
Easier to ride than a regular bike
Silent route, great for spotting wildlife
No engine noise or dust

itinerary.title: Arrival and fitting
itinerary.text: Sign-in, helmet and saddle adjustment. Walkthrough of the assist levels.

itinerary.title: Practice
itinerary.text: A short loop so you feel how the assist kicks in as you pedal.

itinerary.title: Desert
itinerary.text: Route through the cardones with a photo stop at the lookout.

itinerary.title: Beach
itinerary.text: Descent to the Pacific shoreline and the flat stretch facing the sea.

itinerary.title: Return and tequila
itinerary.text: Back to camp and tequila tasting.

bici-montana.name: Mountain Bike
bici-montana.tagline: Trail, riverbed and beach on leg power alone
bici-montana.desc:
Suspension mountain bikes for anyone who actually wants the effort. A route along desert singletrack, across the riverbed and out to the beach, with the guide setting a pace that adjusts to the group.

It's the most affordable tour we run and the one that connects you best with the terrain: you hear the desert instead of an engine.
highlights: Bikes with front suspension
Singletrack, riverbed and beach route
Pace adjusted to the group
The most affordable option in the catalogue

itinerary.title: Arrival and fitting
itinerary.text: Sign-in, helmet and bike adjusted to your height.

itinerary.title: Warm-up
itinerary.text: A short loop to check brakes and gears before heading out.

itinerary.title: Trail and riverbed
itinerary.text: Desert singletrack and the riverbed crossing.

itinerary.title: Beach
itinerary.text: Out to the Pacific shoreline, the flat stretch of the route.

itinerary.title: Return and tequila
itinerary.text: Back to camp and tequila tasting.

combo-2x1.name: 2-in-1 Combo
combo-2x1.tagline: Two activities in one outing, for the price of one and a half
combo-2x1.desc:
One hour of each activity, without coming back a second day or paying for two transfers. The most requested pairing is ATV plus camel, but you can build your own from any two standard activities.

It's the best value we offer, especially if you're short on time in Cabo or arriving on a cruise.
highlights: Two activities in a single two-hour outing
You choose the combination
One transfer, one entrance
The favorite among cruise passengers

itinerary.title: Arrival and gear
itinerary.text: Sign-in and gear for the first activity you chose.

itinerary.title: First activity
itinerary.text: A full hour: usually the ATV, through desert, riverbed and beach.

itinerary.title: Switch
itinerary.text: Back to camp, water and a gear change.

itinerary.title: Second activity
itinerary.text: The second hour: camel, horse or Sky Bike, depending on what you picked.

itinerary.title: Wrap-up and tequila
itinerary.text: Tequila tasting and the ride back to your hotel.

combo-2x1-premium.name: 2-in-1 Combo Premium
combo-2x1-premium.tagline: Same format, built around the high-end machines
combo-2x1-premium.desc:
The 2-in-1 assembled with premium vehicles: a Can-Am X3 or automatic 4x4 ATV for the motorized half, plus whichever activity you choose for the second hour.

More power, extended route and smaller groups. For anyone who wants the combo but not the standard machine.
highlights: High-end machines on the motorized half
Extended route in the first hour
Groups capped at 10 people
Second activity of your choice

itinerary.title: Arrival and briefing
itinerary.text: Sign-in and a walkthrough specific to the premium vehicle you chose.

itinerary.title: First premium activity
itinerary.text: An hour on a Can-Am X3 or automatic ATV, on the extended route.

itinerary.title: Switch
itinerary.text: Back to camp, water and a gear change.

itinerary.title: Second activity
itinerary.text: Camel, horse or Sky Bike, depending on what you picked.

itinerary.title: Wrap-up and tequila
itinerary.text: Tequila tasting and the ride back to your hotel.

includes: Two activities, one on a premium machine

combo-3x1.name: 3-in-1 Combo
combo-3x1.tagline: Three activities in three hours — the most complete outing
combo-3x1.desc:
One hour each of three different activities. It's how you see the whole park in a single visit: motor, animals and heights in the same morning.

It works out cheaper than booking the three separately, and since everything happens in one place you lose no time to transfers.
highlights: Three different activities in one outing
Three hours of total riding time
Much cheaper than booking separately
The most complete option in the catalogue

itinerary.title: Arrival and gear
itinerary.text: Sign-in and gear for the first of your three activities.

itinerary.title: First activity
itinerary.text: One hour, usually the ATV through desert and riverbed.

itinerary.title: Second activity
itinerary.text: Gear change and an hour of camel or horseback riding.

itinerary.title: Third activity
itinerary.text: The last hour: Sky Bike over the canyon, or whichever activity you chose.

itinerary.title: Wrap-up and tequila
itinerary.text: Tequila tasting and the ride back to your hotel.

combo-balandra.name: Balandra Combo
combo-balandra.tagline: Full day: Balandra Beach, La Paz and an activity at Migriño
combo-balandra.desc:
Twelve hours to see the best of Baja California Sur in a single day. We head out early for Balandra Beach — the one with the mushroom rock, widely considered the most beautiful beach in Mexico — with time to swim and eat along the La Paz waterfront.

On the way back we stop at Migriño for an activity of your choice before dropping you at your hotel. It's a long day, but it's the one people remember from the trip.
highlights: Balandra Beach, the most beautiful in Mexico
Free time on the La Paz waterfront
An adventure activity on the way back
Transportation and guide all day

itinerary.title: Early departure
itinerary.text: We pick you up at your hotel and head for La Paz, about three hours with a rest stop.

itinerary.title: Balandra Beach
itinerary.text: Time to swim in clear water and walk out to the mushroom rock.

itinerary.title: La Paz waterfront
itinerary.text: Lunch and free time along the malecón.

itinerary.title: Migriño
itinerary.text: Return trip with a stop at the park for your chosen activity.

itinerary.title: Back to your hotel
itinerary.text: We drop you back where we picked you up.
